pages_or_slides.snippet: A decision problem is classified as NP-hard if every problem in the class NP  (Non-deterministic Polynomial time) can be polynomial-time reduced to it. This  means that if you can solve the NP-hard problem efficiently, you can solve any  problem in NP efficiently through a polynomial-time reduction.
